payload.tension: The passage states 2 Kings 21:4–8 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
